examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

examples.trans: Once all twenty-eight birch clothespins were lettered, Qing sighed with relief and called out, Mission accomplished!

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一整天 ('a whole day').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.trans: Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and not a bit of cold wind!

examples.trans: The sun is lovely today; let's go and sit in the courtyard.

examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.trans: That okay is good.

meanings.note: Adverb hǎodǎi ('at the very least, after all').

examples.trans: At least you are a department director; stop muddling things.

examples.text: 出门前好歹喝口热汤吧。
examples.trans: Have at least a sip of warm soup before heading out.

examples.text: 生活安排的二重奏比我们自己写得更妙，孩子们。
examples.trans: Life arranges finer duets than we write ourselves, boys.

examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 七点整——比早餐早半个小时。
examples.trans: Seven sharp—half an hour earlier than breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn. Measure word (量词): 座 (zuò), e.g. 一座小院 ('a small courtyard').

examples.trans: Property Transfer Notice: Courtyard Building Eight offered for sale as commercial offices.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Colloquial question word gànmá ('what for, why').

examples.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao, what is writing this paper for?

examples.text: 女朋友要是会治病，那还要医生干嘛？
examples.trans: If girlfriends cured illnesses, what would we need doctors for?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò wèi. Combines 座 ('seat/place') + 位 ('spot/position'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 九号房里的十二个室内座位既明亮又宽敞。
examples.trans: The twelve indoor seats inside Room Nine are both bright and spacious.

examples.text: 请给面包师和音乐老师在钢琴旁边留两个好座位。
examples.trans: Please save two good seats beside the piano for the baker and the music teacher.

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

examples.trans: I'll carry this poster steadily in both hands straight over to the wooden easel outside.

examples.trans: Leaving the inn gate, Hao and Peng headed straight toward platform three at Central Station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Read de after a verb to introduce how it goes (走得快 'walk fast'); read děi before a verb to mean 'must'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 老陈修门锁的手艺稳当得很。
examples.trans: Chen's craftsmanship in fixing door locks is rock-steady.

meanings.en: bustle about; keep busy with chores
meanings.note: Pinyin: máng huo. Warm colloquial verb for working busily.

examples.trans: Mei, please do not go to extra trouble on our account.

examples.text: 她在厨房里忙活了一整个早上。
examples.trans: She bustled around the kitchen all morning long.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng dū. Historic southwestern Chinese city famed for courtyards and tea houses.

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.trans: In the morning you can have black tea or a cup of hot coffee.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

捧.gloss: to hold carefully in both hands

meanings.note: Pinyin: pěng. Conveys care and respect—holding a hot teacup, a large poster, or a freshly baked cake.

examples.text: 我会用双手稳稳捧着这张海报，径直走到外面的木画架那儿。

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǎn. Describes a full cup or a fully booked hotel.

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Used as a verb ('drip') or measure word for drops of liquid.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huī. Stative colour adjective ('grey'); also used as a noun for dust/ash.

examples.text: 我每天走过那几扇灰窗板，竟然都没注意到它们。
examples.trans: I walked past those grey shutters every day and stopped noticing them.

examples.text: 这些干燥的灰木头明天刷上暖绿油漆就漂亮了。
examples.trans: Once this dry grey wood gets brushed with warm green paint tomorrow, it will look lovely.

meanings.note: Noun àihào ('personal hobby').

examples.text: 收藏同一本书是您的特殊爱好吗？
examples.trans: Is collecting editions of one book your special hobby?

examples.text: 工作之余，她的爱好是研究老电影。
examples.trans: Outside work, her hobby is studying classic films.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà. Used for drawing blueprints or painting signs.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

examples.text: 门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
examples.trans: Only a golden key painted above the door. Show the clerk the old valve.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.en: imperial household; royal (often used before nouns)
meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng jiā. Modifies nouns directly, e.g. 皇家园林 ('imperial garden').

examples.text: 哎呀，周经理，你这蓝钢笔字写得跟皇家音乐会节目单似的！
examples.trans: My goodness, Zhou, your blue fountain-pen lettering looks just like a royal concert program!

examples.text: 志鹏端出红丝绒托盘时故意挺直腰板，惹得大家笑他像皇家侍者。
examples.trans: Peng stood comically straight carrying the velvet tray, making everyone tease him for acting like a royal footman.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 你瞧，窗台上的茉莉花今天早上全开了！
examples.trans: Look—the jasmine flowers on the windowsill all bloomed this morning!

examples.text: 快去瞧瞧，是谁把这包点心留在门廊的长椅上了？
examples.trans: Go take a quick look—who left this parcel of pastries on the porch bench?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wén wěn. Reduplicated adverb describing steady hands or footing.

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

examples.text: 她双手稳稳地端起盛满热茶的托盘。
examples.trans: With both hands she lifted the tray of hot tea steadily.

meanings.note: ordinal number

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

examples.text: 我是传媒学院的研究生，年级第一名。
examples.trans: I am a graduate student at the Media College, first in my year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张纸 ('a sheet of paper').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

related.gloss: a sheet of paper (measure word 张)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo huā jìng. Combines 老花 ('presbyopia / farsightedness of middle age') + 镜 ('glasses/lenses'); measure word: 副 (fù).

examples.text: 周经理摸了摸额头问：“等等——我的老花镜现在是不是又架在额头上？”
examples.trans: Manager Zhou felt his forehead and asked, 'Wait—are my reading glasses perched up on my forehead again right now?'

examples.text: 老陈看细小的钢琴零件时，总会从口袋里拿出那副老花镜戴上。
examples.trans: Whenever Chen inspects tiny piano parts, he takes that pair of reading glasses out of his pocket and puts them on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.en: work of art; piece of fine craftsmanship
meanings.note: Pinyin: yì shù pǐn. Measure word: 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件艺术品 ('a work of art').

examples.text: 抄一遍？小晴，干嘛把一件艺术品藏进落灰的铅笔本子里？
examples.trans: Copy it? Why hide a work of art inside a dusty pencil notebook, Qing?

examples.text: 老教授手绘的梧桐巷水彩地图，挂在大厅里真像一件珍贵的艺术品。
examples.trans: The old professor's hand-painted watercolor map of Wutong Lane looks like a true work of art in the lobby.

节目.gloss: program; show; item on a bill

meanings.en: TV or radio program; show; performance item
meanings.note: jiémù — takes classifiers 档 (dàng, for a scheduled TV/variety series, e.g., 一档综艺节目) or 个 (gè, for an individual show or performance act); collocates with 录 (tape/record) and 播 (broadcast).

examples.text: 我问你个问题，节目制作的核心业务在哪儿？
examples.trans: Let me ask you a question: where does the core business of show production lie?

examples.text: 明天就要录节目了，那咱们现在怎么办啊？
examples.trans: We are taping the show tomorrow — what do we do now?

related.gloss: schedule; booking notice for an artist

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: luò. Used both literally for raindrops/leaves falling and musically for a phrase landing on a note (落在中央瑞音上).

examples.text: 到了第二十八小节，整段旋律稳稳落在了中央瑞音上。
examples.trans: In bar twenty-eight, the whole melody lands squarely on middle D.

examples.text: 几片金黄的梧桐叶轻轻落在院子的石桌上。
examples.trans: Several golden plane-tree leaves drifted gently down onto the courtyard stone table.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lán. Describes blue suitcases, doors, or teacups.

examples.text: 每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
examples.trans: Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.

examples.text: 储藏室里有两个软枕头和一块蓝地毯！
examples.trans: In the storeroom there are two soft pillows and a blue rug!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cáng. Read cáng for 'hide'; often followed by 在 + place (藏在走廊里 'hidden in the hallway').

examples.text: 一扇真的门，就藏在走廊里！
examples.trans: A real door, hidden right here in the hallway!

examples.text: 小猫藏在桌子下面。
examples.trans: The kitten is hiding under the table.

meanings.en: neighbors; folks on the same street
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē fang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位街坊 ('a neighborhood resident').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhàng běn. Measure word (量词): 本 (běn), e.g. 一本账本 ('an account ledger').

examples.text: 说得对。公事等一等——先放在账本旁边。
examples.trans: Right you are. Paperwork can wait—set it beside the ledger for now.

examples.text: 每天关门以前，经理都会核对一遍账本。
examples.trans: Before closing up each night, the manager checks the ledger.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǒu. Means 'walk' (走路, 直走) or 'leave / head off' (我先走了).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.en: to step out over a threshold or boundary
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuà chū. Pairs 跨 ('stride over') with outward 出 ('out').

examples.text: 你跨出门槛之前，好歹先把老花镜架到鼻梁上呀！
examples.trans: At least put your reading glasses onto the bridge of your nose before you cross the threshold!

examples.text: 志豪接过迎宾牌，大步跨出石拱门往车站走去。
examples.trans: Taking the welcome sign, Hao strode out past the stone archway toward the station.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lù. Measure word (量词): 条 (tiáo), e.g. 一条路 ('a road').

examples.text: 走花摊旁边第二条路，别进窄巷子。
examples.trans: Take the second lane beside the flower stall; do not enter the narrow alley.

examples.text: 雨停了，石板路还有点滑。
examples.trans: The rain stopped, and the stone path is still a bit slippery.

meanings.en: and also; in addition; still have
meanings.note: Pinyin: hái yǒu. Adds another item to a list ('plus…').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè me. Proximal degree adverb (这么快 'this fast', 这么重 'so heavy').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jìn. Movement into an enclosed space (请进 'come in!', 倒进 'pour into').

examples.text: 小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
examples.trans: Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lián. Pairs with 都/也 to highlight 'even X' (连名字都一样), or means 'connect' as a verb.

examples.text: 老房子连着旧回忆——那种争吵最伤人。
examples.trans: Old houses are tied to old memories—arguments like that cut deepest.

examples.text: 笔挺又干净，周经理！连眼镜都戴在鼻子上，没在额头上。
examples.trans: Crisp and spotless, Manager Zhou! Even your glasses are on your nose instead of your forehead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nàr. Spoken variant of 那里 ('there').

examples.text: 因为楼梯窄，而且周经理在那儿放了旧灯箱子。
examples.trans: Because the stairs are narrow, and Manager Zhou put old lamp boxes up there.

examples.text: 看车轮底下——铅笔写的你和我的名字还在那儿。
examples.trans: Look underneath the wheels—your name and mine in pencil are still right there.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn càn càn. Vivid ABB-style color adjective for sunshine, baked crusts, or autumn leaves.

examples.text: 宋老师，今天成都连半朵雨云都没有——满天都是金灿灿的太阳！
examples.trans: There isn't half a raincloud in Chengdu today, Song—pure golden sunshine everywhere!

examples.text: 四个浆果蛋糕烤得金灿灿的，还没切开就让人直流口水。
examples.trans: The four berry cakes baked to a bright golden brown, making everyone's mouth water before a slice was cut.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支钢笔 ('a fountain pen').

examples.text: 太棒了！用钢笔把你的名字正式写进老陈的大纸本子里！
examples.trans: Wonderful! Your name goes into Chen's big paper ledger in fountain-pen ink!

examples.text: 他从上衣口袋里拿出一支黑色钢笔。
examples.trans: He took a black fountain pen from his jacket pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qiān bǐ. Measure word (量词): 支, e.g. 一支铅笔 ('a pencil').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 上面怎么用铅笔整齐画了这条街三家客栈？
examples.trans: Why are three inns on this street neatly sketched in pencil on it?

meanings.note: Literally a doorway sill; figuratively an entry standard.

examples.text: 来拜访的人太多，门槛都快被踩平了。
examples.trans: So many visitors came that the threshold was nearly worn flat.

examples.text: 这档专业音乐节目的准入门槛很高。
examples.trans: The entry bar for this professional music show is high.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ yún. Measure word: 朵 (duǒ) or 片 (piàn), e.g. 半朵雨云 ('half a raincloud').

examples.text: 宋老师，今天成都连半朵雨云都没有——满天都是金灿灿的太阳！
examples.trans: There isn't half a raincloud in Chengdu today, Song—pure golden sunshine everywhere!

examples.text: 刚才天边还有一小朵雨云，这会儿早被微风吹散啦。
examples.trans: There was a tiny raincloud on the horizon earlier, and by now the breeze has blown it clear away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn yuè. Measure word (量词): 首 (shǒu), e.g. 一首音乐 ('a piece of music').

examples.text: 一点回声也没有！木头和玻璃让音乐更好听。
examples.trans: No echo at all! Wood and glass make music sound even better.

examples.text: 每个星期五六点！整条街的人都来这儿喝茶听音乐！
examples.trans: Every Friday at six! People from the whole street came here for tea and music!

related.gloss: a piece of music (measure word 首)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷雨中走过来之后，这听起来太棒了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After that cold walk in the rain, that sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bí liáng. Measure word: 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo); classic spot where glasses rest.

examples.text: 你跨出门槛之前，好歹先把老花镜架到鼻梁上呀！
examples.trans: At least put your reading glasses onto the bridge of your nose before you cross the threshold!

examples.text: 周经理笑着推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，细细念起成都老院文化节的来信。
examples.trans: Smiling, Manager Zhou nudged the glasses up the bridge of his nose and read the Historic Courtyard Festival letter aloud.
